name: NGC 3585 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3585, an elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3585-hubble
story: This frame reaches out across the body of the elliptical galaxy NGC 3585, beyond earlier views of its center. Paired with X-ray images, it helps trace how the X-ray binaries scattered through a galaxy fade as its stars grow old.

claims.text: NGC 3585 is an elliptical galaxy (type E7)
NGC3585-A is an offset ACS field that extends coverage beyond archival data of the galaxy's center, for a mosaic covering the galaxy
Program 14852 combines Chandra and HST to measure how field low-mass X-ray binaries evolve with stellar age, predicted to decline with age
